680	/// `record_screen`'s SENTENCES (camera-recording CR3-0): an error's sentence,
681	/// the start's and the finish's timeout sentences with the alert clause they
682	/// share, and `savedButNotAdded`, a failure after the files are on disk. A
683	/// pure move out of `AgentServer+RecordingResult.swift` at the 400-line cap,
684	/// landed alone before camera + screen grows the result; nothing changed,
685	/// and `isStartTimeout` stays `private`, because only `startSentence` calls
686	/// it. Every member is `static` and reads nothing off the server, the rule
687	/// the result file was cut by.
688	extension AgentServer {
689	    // MARK: - The sentences
690	
691	    /// An error's sentence — a `ToolError`'s `localizedDescription` is generic.
692	    static func sentence(of error: any Error) -> String {
693	        (error as? ToolError)?.message ?? error.localizedDescription
694	    }
695	
696	    /// The clause both of the tool's timeout sentences end with, and the
697	    /// recorder's own arm timeout gets it too: macOS 15 periodically puts up
698	    /// a consent alert — whether to keep letting Frame Job bypass the system
699	    /// window picker — which is a prompt neither `CGPreflightScreenCaptureAccess`
700	    /// (still true) nor this tool can see, and a capture waiting behind it
701	    /// looks exactly like a recorder that hung.
702	    static let recordingAlertClause =
703	        " A system alert about screen recording may be waiting on the screen — macOS "
704	        + "periodically asks whether to keep allowing Frame Job to record, and neither the "
705	        + "preflight nor this tool can see that prompt; answer it and call again."
706	
707	    /// The start's failure as the caller reads it: the recorder's sentence,
708	    /// plus the alert clause when the recorder's own arm ceiling is what
709	    /// answered (`.startTimedOut`, bare or wrapped in `.filesKept`).
710	    static func startSentence(of error: any Error) -> String {
711	        sentence(of: error) + (isStartTimeout(error) ? recordingAlertClause : "")
712	    }
713	
714	    private static func isStartTimeout(_ error: any Error) -> Bool {
715	        guard let failure = error as? RecorderError else { return false }
716	        switch failure {
717	        case .startTimedOut: return true
718	        case .filesKept(let inner, _, _): return isStartTimeout(inner)
719	        default: return false
720	        }
721	    }
722	
723	    /// The sentence for a `stop()` that did not conclude within
724	    /// `stopCeiling(segments:camera:)`: it names every movie the recorder still
725	    /// holds — one per segment, the recording may finish on its own after
726	    /// the tool has answered, and a person can then import them — and the
727	    /// alert clause. Empty means the recorder no longer holds a session at
728	    /// all. The seconds it spells are the ceiling over `movies.count`, which
729	    /// is the number the wait used: the same count while the session is
730	    /// held (a stop removes no segment), and the one-segment number — the
731	    /// wait's own `?? 1` — when the recorder had let the session go. A
732	    /// voice-over's files are named "file", not "movie". `cameras` are the
733	    /// camera files beside a screen's movies (spec §11 CAM-10 (7)), named
734	    /// after them. `camera` is the wait's own `cameraBeside`, so the ceiling
735	    /// spelled is the one the wait used — with the camera's probe whenever a
736	    /// camera was asked for beside the screen, even when no camera file is
737	    /// held (CAM-11 (7)).
738	    static func finishTimeoutSentence(
739	        movies: [String], cameras: [String] = [], camera: Bool = false, voiceOver: Bool = false
740	    ) -> String {
741	        let noun = voiceOver ? "file" : "movie"
742	        let where_: String
743	        switch movies.count {
744	        case 0:
745	            where_ =
746	                "The recorder no longer holds the session, so the recording may already have "
747	                + "finished without answering."
748	        case 1:

784	/// `record_screen`'s LANDING (camera-recording CR3-0): `awaitGestureEnd`, the
785	/// wait for a target document's drag to end, and `land`, the two doors a
786	/// finished recording takes — a document through `editResult`, a new project
787	/// through `ProjectDocument.untitled(around:)`. A pure move out of
788	/// `AgentServer+Recording.swift` at the 400-line cap, landed alone before
789	/// camera + screen grows the tool; nothing in either body changed, and
790	/// `private` → internal is the whole cost, because a `private` extension
791	/// member reaches only its own file. What the answer and its refusals say is
792	/// `AgentServer+RecordingResult.swift` and `+RecordingSentences.swift`.
793	extension AgentServer {
794	    // MARK: - The landing
795	
796	    /// SERVER THREAD. A target document mid-drag is not committed over the
797	    /// gesture's base handle (`RecordingLanding.placement` refuses by name);
798	    /// the panel retries from a half-second timer bounded at forty tries,
799	    /// and this polls `isLiveEditing` through `onMain` at that interval and
800	    /// bound BY NAME, so the two doors cannot drift. A gesture outlasting
801	    /// the bound still reaches `placement`'s refusal, which names the file;
802	    /// a `.newProject` target or a closed document has nothing to wait for.
803	    func awaitGestureEnd(_ destination: RecordingDestination) {
804	        for _ in 0..<RecorderPanelController.landingRetryLimit {
805	            let dragging = onMain { () -> Bool in
806	                guard case .document(let document) = RecordingLanding.resolve(destination)
807	                else { return false }
808	                return document.isLiveEditing
809	            }
810	            guard dragging else { return }
811	            Thread.sleep(forTimeInterval: RecorderPanelController.landingRetryInterval)
812	        }
813	    }

815	    /// MAIN. The two doors: a document through `editResult` (one undo step,
816	    /// the `created` ids, the scope landing); a new project through
817	    /// `ProjectDocument.untitled(around:)`, which does everything. Every
818	    /// throw past this point is `savedButNotAdded`'s: every segment's files
819	    /// exist. The result is `recordingFields` over the segments plus the ids
820	    /// each door knows them by (the placement's lists, predicted before the
821	    /// commit; the new project's snapshot, read by path), and `note` is the
822	    /// door's sentences in order: `place: false`, a closed target, what the
823	    /// landing could NOT place (each naming its file), then `resultNotes(result)`.
824	    /// Answers the document it landed in beside the answer, for
825	    /// `landAndEnhance`.
826	    func land(_ result: RecordingResult, place: Bool) throws
827	        -> (answer: String, document: ProjectDocument)
828	    {
829	        var fields: [String: Any]
830	        var notes: [String] = []
831	        switch RecordingLanding.resolve(result.choice.destination) {
832	        case .document(let document):
833	            let placement: RecordingLanding.Placement
834	            do {
835	                placement = try RecordingLanding.placement(result, in: document, place: place)
836	            } catch {
837	                throw Self.savedButNotAdded(result, error)
838	            }
839	            fields = Self.recordingFields(
840	                result, ids: Self.documentIds(result, placement: placement),
841	                leftOutIds: Self.documentLeftOutIds(result, placement: placement))
842	            fields["landed"] = "document"
843	            if !place {
844	                notes.append(
845	                    "The recording is in the project's media list but not on the timeline — "
846	                        + "place it with add_clip {track, media, at}.")
847	            }
848	            notes.append(contentsOf: placement.notes)
849	            notes.append(contentsOf: Self.resultNotes(result))
850	            if !notes.isEmpty { fields["note"] = notes.joined(separator: " ") }
851	            let answer: String
852	            do {
853	                answer = try editResult(document, RecordingLanding.actionName, placement.ops, fields)
854	            } catch {
855	                throw Self.savedButNotAdded(result, error)
856	            }
857	            // `editResult` commits and does not build caches; `importMedia`
858	            // calls this after its own commit for the same reason.
859	            document.generateCaches()
860	            return (answer, document)
861	        case .newProject:
862	            let document: ProjectDocument
863	            var landingNotes: [String] = []
864	            do {
865	                let landing = try ProjectDocument.untitled(around: result)
866	                document = landing.document
867	                landingNotes = landing.notes
868	            } catch {
869	                throw Self.savedButNotAdded(result, error)
870	            }
871	            fields = Self.recordingFields(
872	                result, ids: Self.newProjectIds(result, in: document),
873	                leftOutIds: Self.newProjectLeftOutIds(result, in: document))
874	            fields["landed"] = "new_project"
875	            if result.choice.destination != .newProject {
876	                notes.append(
877	                    "The target document closed while the recording ran, so it opened as a "
878	                        + "new project instead.")
879	            }
880	            if !place {
881	                notes.append(
882	                    "place: false has no meaning for a new project — the "
883	                        + (result.isVoiceOver ? "voice-over" : "picture") + " IS the "
884	                        + "document, so its clips are on the timeline, one per segment and "
885	                        + "the first at 0.")
886	            }
887	            notes.append(contentsOf: landingNotes)
888	            notes.append(contentsOf: Self.resultNotes(result))
889	            if !notes.isEmpty { fields["note"] = notes.joined(separator: " ") }
890	            fields["ok"] = true
891	            fields["project"] = summary(document)
892	            return (try jsonResult(fields), document)
893	        }
894	    }
895	
896	    /// SERVER THREAD. `land` on main, and in the same hop, when the choice
897	    /// asks for it, Remove Background over the camera clips as its own step
898	    /// (road map creator-jobs CO8, spec §11 CO-81, `camera_cutout` or
899	    /// `camera_cutout_error`); then, when the choice asks for it,
900	    /// Enhance Voice over the recording's voice clips as its own step (spec
901	    /// §11 AU-68 (f)): `decide` polled through `onMain` every
902	    /// `RecordingEnhance.checkInterval`, then `enhance_voice`'s own body at
903	    /// its default target (a tool reads no `UserDefaults`); then, when it asks
904	    /// for any, the polish on landing (road map creator-jobs CU10, spec §11
905	    /// CU-101 (j), `polishLanded`). The answer is `land`'s with `enhance`
906	    /// (that body's answer) or `enhance_error`, the polish's answers or
907	    /// `…_error` sentences, and `project` read again, last, when any ran.
908	    func landAndEnhance(_ result: RecordingResult, place: Bool) throws -> String {
909	        let stop = AgentLane.shared.callCancel
910	        let (answer, document, cutout) = try onMain {
911	            () throws -> (String, ProjectDocument, [UInt32]) in
912	            let (answer, document) = try self.land(result, place: place)
913	            // CO-81: Remove Background, its own step, before Enhance Voice and the polish.
914	            return (answer, document, RecordingCutout.apply(result, in: document))
915	        }
916	        let polish = !RecordingPolish.commands(of: result.choice).isEmpty
917	        let wantsCutout = result.choice.cameraCutout
918	        guard result.choice.enhanceMicrophone || polish || wantsCutout else { return answer }
919	        var fields = Self.resultObject(answer) ?? [:]
920	        if wantsCutout {
921	            if cutout.isEmpty {
922	                fields["camera_cutout_error"] = RecordingCutout.noCameraSentence
923	            } else {
924	                fields["camera_cutout"] = ["clips": cutout]
925	            }
926	        }
927	        if result.choice.enhanceMicrophone {
928	            try enhanceLanded(result, in: document, stop: stop, into: &fields)
929	        }
930	        if polish { polishLanded(result, in: document, into: &fields) }
931	        fields["project"] = onMain { self.summary(document) }
932	        return try jsonResult(fields)
933	    }

935	    /// SERVER THREAD. AU-68 (f)'s wait and Enhance Voice, its answer or
936	    /// `enhance_error` written into `fields`.
937	    private func enhanceLanded(
938	        _ result: RecordingResult, in document: ProjectDocument, stop: AgentCallCancel?,
939	        into fields: inout [String: Any]
940	    ) throws {
941	        let (clips, scope) = onMain {
942	            (RecordingEnhance.voiceClips(of: result, in: document), document.scope)
943	        }
944	        let started = Date()
945	        var step = RecordingEnhance.Step.wait
946	        while step == .wait, stop?.isCancelled != true {
947	            step = onMain { () -> RecordingEnhance.Step in
948	                let present = RecordingEnhance.present(clips, in: document)
949	                return RecordingEnhance.decide(
950	                    clips: present, analysed: RecordingEnhance.isAnalysed(present, in: document),
951	                    busy: RecordingEnhance.isBusy(document, scope: scope),
952	                    elapsed: Date().timeIntervalSince(started))
953	            }
954	            if step == .wait { Thread.sleep(forTimeInterval: RecordingEnhance.checkInterval) }
955	        }
956	        switch step {
957	        case .enhance(let ids):
958	            do {
959	                let enhanced = try enhanceVoice(
960	                    document: document, clips: ids, targetLUFS: AudioNormalize.defaultTargetLUFS)
961	                fields["enhance"] = Self.resultObject(enhanced) ?? enhanced
962	            } catch let error as ToolError {
963	                fields["enhance_error"] = error.message
964	            }
965	        case .drop:
966	            fields["enhance_error"] = RecordingEnhance.noVoiceSentence
967	        case .giveUp:
968	            fields["enhance_error"] = RecordingEnhance.notReadyToolSentence
969	        case .wait:
970	            fields["enhance_error"] =
971	                "record_screen was stopped while the microphone's sound was being analysed, so "
972	                + "Enhance Voice did not run."
973	        }
974	    }
975	
976	    /// The object a `jsonResult` envelope's text holds, nil for anything else.
977	    static func resultObject(_ envelope: String) -> [String: Any]? {
978	        guard
979	            let call = (try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: Data(envelope.utf8)))
980	                as? [String: Any],
981	            let content = call["content"] as? [[String: Any]],
982	            let text = content.first?["text"] as? String
983	        else { return nil }
984	        return (try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: Data(text.utf8))) as? [String: Any]
985	    }
986	}

266	/// failed, or a build that threw → its sentence, never retried; else
267	/// prepare. The grant is read only at its own step, through
268	/// `grantDoors.cameraStatus`, so showing the panel never prompts and a
269	/// hidden panel reads nothing.
270	///
271	/// **The sync** runs at the end of `show()`, of every control change, of
272	/// `syncPhase()`, at the one-second tick while the panel is visible, and at
273	/// each device notification. Its first act applies a pending hot-plug
274	/// (`+Devices.swift`, CAM-8 (2)), so the step sees the new selection. It
275	/// keeps the row's visibility (refitting the window when it changes), lets
276	/// the prepared capture go when the well is off or shows a sentence while
277	/// everything is idle, stops a failed prepared capture once (not at every
278	/// tick, CAM-8 (6)), and otherwise hosts the layer the step names. The
279	/// capture is the recorder's (`ScreenRecorder+CameraPrepare.swift`): the
280	/// countdown's `prepareCamera` keeps it, the panel's start adopts it, and a
281	/// tool's start never does (CAM-7 (7)), so through a tool's recording the
282	/// well reads "The camera is recording."
283	extension RecorderPanelController {
284	    static let previewGrantSentence = "The preview shows once Frame Job may use the camera."
285	    static let previewRecordingSentence = "The camera is recording."
286	
287	    /// CAM-7 (3)'s rule. `grant` and `failure` are called only at their own
288	    /// steps.
289	    static func cameraPreviewStep(
290	        visible: Bool, cameraSource: Bool, phase: Phase, recorderIdle: Bool,
291	        recordingCamera: Bool, cameraChosen: Bool, grant: () -> AVAuthorizationStatus,
292	        failure: () -> String?
293	    ) -> CameraPreviewStep {
294	        guard visible, cameraSource else { return .off }
295	        if recordingCamera { return .recording }
296	        switch phase {
297	        case .countdown, .starting: return .prepared
298	        case .idle: break
299	        case .recording, .paused, .stopping, .landing: return .blank
300	        }
301	        guard recorderIdle else { return .blank }
302	        guard cameraChosen else { return .message(CameraDevices.noCameraSentence) }
303	        guard grant() == .authorized else { return .message(Self.previewGrantSentence) }
304	        if let failure = failure() { return .failed(failure) }
305	        return .prepare
306	    }
307	
308	    /// The well's grid row.
309	    var cameraPreviewRow: NSGridRow? {
310	        (cameraPreview.superview as? NSGridView)?.cell(for: cameraPreview)?.row
311	    }
312	
313	    /// For the chosen camera at its resolved format (CAM-6 (3)): the
314	    /// prepared capture's stop on its own, else its failed start, else a
315	    /// failed build's record; nil when there is none.
316	    var previewFailure: String? {
317	        guard let id = selectedCameraID, let device = CameraDevices.device(withID: id) else {
318	            return nil
319	        }
320	        let facts = CameraDevices.facts(of: device)
321	        guard
322	            let format = CameraDevices.chosenFormat(
323	                selectedCameraFormat, in: facts.formats, active: facts.activeFormat)
324	        else { return nil }
325	        if let prepared = recorder.preparedCamera, prepared.deviceID == id, prepared.format == format,
326	            let sentence = prepared.stoppedOnItsOwn ?? prepared.startError?.localizedDescription
327	        {
328	            return sentence
329	        }
330	        guard let failure = recorder.preparedCameraFailure, failure.deviceID == id,
331	            failure.format == format
332	        else { return nil }
333	        return failure.sentence
334	    }

336	    /// A pending hot-plug applied (CAM-8 (2)), the row's visibility, then the
337	    /// step acted on (the type doc).
338	    func syncCameraPreview() {
339	        applyPendingDevices()
340	        let hidden = !cameraWanted
341	        if let row = cameraPreviewRow, row.isHidden != hidden {
342	            row.isHidden = hidden
343	            fitWindowToContent()
344	        }
345	        let step = Self.cameraPreviewStep(
346	            visible: window?.isVisible == true && !panelClosing, cameraSource: cameraWanted,
347	            phase: phase, recorderIdle: recorder.state == .idle,
348	            recordingCamera: recorder.cameraSession != nil || recorder.session?.cameraCapture != nil,
349	            cameraChosen: selectedCameraID != nil,
350	            grant: { Self.grantDoors.cameraStatus() }, failure: { self.previewFailure })
351	        switch step {
352	        case .off, .message:
353	            if phase == .idle, recorder.state == .idle { recorder.discardPreparedCamera() }
354	            if case .message(let sentence) = step {
355	                cameraPreview.showMessage(sentence)
356	            } else {
357	                cameraPreview.showMessage(nil)
358	            }
359	        case .failed(let sentence):
360	            if let capture = recorder.preparedCamera?.capture, !capture.stopped { capture.stop() }
361	            cameraPreview.showMessage(sentence)
362	        case .prepare:
363	            recorder.prepareCamera(for: currentChoice())
364	            hostPreview(recorder.preparedCamera?.capture.previewLayer, else: nil)
365	        case .prepared:
366	            hostPreview(recorder.preparedCamera?.capture.previewLayer, else: nil)
367	        case .recording:
368	            hostPreview(
369	                (recorder.cameraSession?.capture ?? recorder.session?.cameraCapture)?.previewLayer,
370	                else: Self.previewRecordingSentence)
371	        case .blank:
372	            cameraPreview.showMessage(nil)
373	        }
374	    }
375	
376	    /// `layer` in the well, else `sentence` (nil a blank well).
377	    private func hostPreview(_ layer: AVCaptureVideoPreviewLayer?, else sentence: String?) {
378	        if let layer {
379	            cameraPreview.show(layer)
380	        } else {
381	            cameraPreview.showMessage(sentence)
382	        }
383	    }
384	}

388	/// One popup row as a hot-plug compares it: the id it carries (nil for
389	/// "None connected" and "Off") and its title.
390	struct HotPlugRow: Equatable {
391	    let id: String?
392	    let title: String
393	}

395	/// Hot-plug (camera-recording CR2c, spec §11 CAM-8) —
396	/// `RecorderPanelController.swift`'s twelfth file, NEW rather than cut, as
397	/// `+Camera.swift` and `+CameraPreview.swift` were: the device observers,
398	/// the pending mark, the rebuild it applies, the selection rule and the
399	/// microphone list.
400	///
401	/// **The observers** are `AVCaptureDevice`'s connected and disconnected
402	/// notifications for any device, on main. `show()` adds the pair (one at
403	/// most) and adding it marks the lists pending, so a change made while the
404	/// panel was closed is caught up; `panelWillClose` removes them. A panel
405	/// ordered out for a recording keeps them.
406	///
407	/// **Pending until idle.** A notification marks the lists pending and steps
408	/// the preview (`syncCameraPreview`), whose FIRST act is
409	/// `applyPendingDevices`: it applies only while the panel's phase and the
410	/// recorder are both idle, so a change during a countdown, a recording or a
411	/// landing waits for the first step that finds both idle — the return to
412	/// idle draws the phase, which steps. It never steps the preview itself (no
413	/// recursion) and never persists.
414	///
415	/// **The rebuild** compares each popup's rows (id, title) with the devices
416	/// connected now and rebuilds only a popup that differs, so a menu the
417	/// person has open is not rebuilt for an unrelated device. The selection is
418	/// `hotPlugSelection` over the id held BEFORE the rebuild; the camera is
419	/// selected again — which rebuilds the Format popup, the stored format else
420	/// Best (CAM-6 (2)) — only when its popup was rebuilt or the id changed.
421	/// **No key is written**, so a camera that goes and comes back is selected
422	/// again with its stored format; the next control change writes what the
423	/// popups then show (CAM-5 (2)).
424	extension RecorderPanelController {
425	
426	    /// CAM-8 (3): `stored` when `listed` holds it, else `current` when
427	    /// listed, else nil (the default). `""` counts as nil for both.
428	    static func hotPlugSelection(listed: [String], stored: String?, current: String?) -> String? {
429	        let stored = stored.flatMap { $0.isEmpty ? nil : $0 }
430	        let current = current.flatMap { $0.isEmpty ? nil : $0 }
431	        if let stored, listed.contains(stored) { return stored }
432	        if let current, listed.contains(current) { return current }
433	        return nil
434	    }
435	
436	    /// The microphones connected now: the discovery session
437	    /// `ScreenRecorder.microphone(withID:)` asks, keeping only those whose
438	    /// `isConnected` is true (CAM-8 (5)).
439	    static func connectedMicrophones() -> [AVCaptureDevice] {
440	        AVCaptureDevice.DiscoverySession(
441	            deviceTypes: [.microphone, .external], mediaType: .audio, position: .unspecified
442	        ).devices.filter(\.isConnected)
443	    }
444	
445	    /// `popup`'s rows as a hot-plug compares them.
446	    static func hotPlugRows(of popup: NSPopUpButton) -> [HotPlugRow] {
447	        popup.itemArray.map { HotPlugRow(id: $0.representedObject as? String, title: $0.title) }
448	    }
449	
450	    // MARK: - The observers
451	
452	    /// Idempotent: one pair at most. Adding the pair marks the lists
453	    /// pending, so the sync that follows catches up a change made while the
454	    /// panel was closed.
455	    func observeDevices() {
456	        guard deviceObservers.isEmpty else { return }
457	        let center = NotificationCenter.default
458	        let names = [AVCaptureDevice.wasConnectedNotification, AVCaptureDevice.wasDisconnectedNotification]
459	        for name in names {
460	            let observer = center.addObserver(forName: name, object: nil, queue: .main) {
461	                [weak self] _ in
462	                self?.devicesDidChange()
463	            }
464	            deviceObservers.append(observer)
465	        }
466	        devicesPending = true
467	    }
468	
469	    /// Removes both observers.
470	    func stopObservingDevices() {
471	        deviceObservers.forEach(NotificationCenter.default.removeObserver)
472	        deviceObservers = []
473	    }
474	
475	    /// A device came or went: the lists are pending, and the preview's step
476	    /// applies them first when the panel and the recorder are idle.
477	    func devicesDidChange() {
478	        devicesPending = true
479	        syncCameraPreview()
480	    }
481	
482	    // MARK: - The rebuild
483	
484	    /// CAM-8 (2)–(4): nothing unless pending and both idle; then each popup
485	    /// rebuilt only when its rows differ from the devices connected now, the
486	    /// selection `hotPlugSelection`'s, and the size note refreshed. Writes
487	    /// no key and never steps the preview.
488	    func applyPendingDevices() {
489	        guard devicesPending else { return }
490	        guard phase == .idle, recorder.state == .idle else { return }
491	        devicesPending = false
492	        let defaults = UserDefaults.standard
493	
494	        let cameras = CameraDevices.connected()
495	        let cameraRows =
496	            cameras.isEmpty
497	            ? [HotPlugRow(id: nil, title: Self.noCameraTitle)]
498	            : cameras.map {
499	                HotPlugRow(id: $0.uniqueID, title: CameraDevices.popupTitle(CameraDevices.facts(of: $0)))
500	            }
501	        let currentCamera = selectedCameraID
502	        let cameraRebuilt = Self.hotPlugRows(of: cameraPopup) != cameraRows
503	        if cameraRebuilt { rebuildCameras() }
504	        let camera = Self.hotPlugSelection(
505	            listed: cameras.map(\.uniqueID), stored: defaults.string(forKey: Self.cameraKey),
506	            current: currentCamera)
507	        if cameraRebuilt || camera != selectedCameraID { selectCamera(camera) }
508	
509	        let microphones = Self.connectedMicrophones()
510	        let microphoneRows =
511	            [HotPlugRow(id: nil, title: "Off")]
512	            + microphones.map { HotPlugRow(id: $0.uniqueID, title: $0.localizedName) }
513	        let currentMicrophone = microphonePopup.selectedItem?.representedObject as? String
514	        if Self.hotPlugRows(of: microphonePopup) != microphoneRows { rebuildMicrophones() }
515	        selectMicrophone(
516	            Self.hotPlugSelection(
517	                listed: microphones.map(\.uniqueID),
518	                stored: defaults.string(forKey: Self.microphoneKey), current: currentMicrophone))
519	        // AU-69 (a): the Enhance box follows a microphone that came or went.
520	        enhanceMicrophoneCheckbox.isEnabled = currentChoice().microphone != nil
521	        refreshSizeNote()
522	    }
523	}

5	/// Everything the recorder panel does from Record pressed to the recording
6	/// RUNNING (road map 3, R1c) — the countdown, the start, the stop —
7	/// `RecorderPanelController.swift`'s third file. The grants a press checks
8	/// first are `+Grants.swift`. The recording's END
9	/// and its landing are `+Landing.swift`, and the window picker is
10	/// `+Picker.swift`, both cut out along the lines `recordingEnded` and
11	/// `presentPicker` draw when the R1 review's fixes put this file past the
12	/// 400-line cap; the pause and the resume, and the phases drawn, are
13	/// `+Pause.swift` (R2c).
14	///
15	/// **Before the grants, the source** (R1 review): Record with the Source row
16	/// reading "Window…" and no picked filter refuses FIRST, by name, and starts
17	/// no countdown — `currentChoice()` would otherwise quietly fall back to the
18	/// main display and record the wrong thing. The picker is NOT presented from
19	/// the guard: a refusal that puts up a system UI is not a refusal. With
20	/// "Record the camera too" ticked (spec §11 CAM-11 (5)) no camera refuses
21	/// next, and the Camera grant is checked between Screen Recording and the
22	/// microphone; with it off the Camera grant is never read.
23	///
24	/// **The start is bounded and numbered** (R1 review). `.starting` used to
25	/// have no ceiling and no exit: `ScreenRecorder.shareableContent` can hold
26	/// its answer for tens of seconds on a locked console (measured ~37 s), and
27	/// a panel waiting on it showed "Starting…" with the button disabled and no
28	/// way back. Now each press of Record is one ATTEMPT with a number
29	/// (`startGeneration`), the lookup's completion carries the number and is
30	/// ignored once it is stale, and a one-shot timer at
31	/// `ScreenRecorder.armCeiling` fails the attempt with `.startTimedOut` while
32	/// the lookup is still pending. Once `launch` has handed the attempt to the
33	/// recorder its own arm ceiling is the bound (the same sentence, from the
34	/// start completion) and the panel's timer is cancelled, so the two cannot
35	/// both fire on one attempt.
36	///
37	/// **Stop while starting** (lane C's flag, closed by reading the seam):
38	/// after `launch` the recorder is arming and `stop()` is HELD — finishing
39	/// begins the moment the start lands, and the end arrives through the
40	/// session's `onFinish` like any other; a start that FAILS instead answers
41	/// the start completion alone, `onFinish` is never called for it, and
42	/// `startFailed` is the only thing that runs. Before `launch` there is
43	/// nothing to stop: `abandonStart` bumps the generation so the pending
44	/// answer is dropped, and the panel goes idle. Without that arm a Stop while
45	/// the lookup was pending left the panel at "Stopping…" for good, because
46	/// the answer then found the phase moved on and did nothing.
47	///
48	/// **The microphone is prepared at the countdown's start** (R1 review;
49	/// `ScreenRecorder+Microphone.swift` says why — `startRunning()`'s first-use
50	/// cost, up to 0.4 s of voice missing from the file) and discarded on cancel,
51	/// on close and on a refused start, so an input never stays open past the
52	/// recording it was for. **So is a camera's capture** (spec §11 CAM-5,
53	/// `ScreenRecorder+CameraPrepare.swift`), so CAM-3's warm-up runs through the
54	/// 3-2-1, and it is let go on the same four occasions. **The meter moves
55	/// during the countdown** (#98 c): `beginCountdown` arms the tick, which
56	/// through `.countdown` and `.starting` does nothing but
57	/// `publishMicrophoneLevel()`, read from the prepared session; the discard
58	/// publishes the silence. **The tick shows a microphone problem the moment
59	/// the recorder reports one**: the picture keeps recording, the meter goes
60	/// silent, and the note says so rather than leaving a dead bar.
61	///
62	/// **Two timers run in `.common` modes** — the countdown and the 30 Hz tick
63	/// — because a status item's menu runs the run loop in event-tracking mode
64	/// while it is open, and a default-mode timer stalls there: the elapsed
65	/// label in the menu bar froze at the one moment a person was looking at
66	/// it. `RecorderStatusItem`'s doc carries the same sentence from its side.
67	extension RecorderPanelController {
68	    /// The note for Record pressed over "Window…" with nothing picked.
69	    static let chooseWindowSentence = "Choose a window with Window… first, or pick a display."
70	    /// The note for a Stop that arrived before the recording had begun.
71	    static let abandonedSentence = "Stopped before the recording began; nothing was recorded."
72	
73	    // MARK: - Record and Stop
74	
75	    /// The Record button in every phase: start, cancel the countdown, or
76	    /// stop; a beep while the recorder is finishing or the panel is adding.
77	    @objc func record(_ sender: Any?) {
78	        switch phase {
79	        case .idle:
80	            beginIfGranted()
81	        case .countdown:
82	            cancelCountdown()
83	        case .recording, .paused, .starting:
84	            stopRecording()
85	        case .stopping, .landing:
86	            NSSound.beep()
87	        }
88	    }
89	
90	    /// Stop, from the panel's button, the status item's menu or File ▸ Stop
91	    /// Recording. A recording the panel did not start (the `record_screen`
92	    /// tool's) is not this panel's to stop — `AppDelegate.newRecording`
93	    /// routes that one to the recorder directly — so anything but a panel
94	    /// recording beeps. Paused is stopped exactly as recording is: the
95	    /// recorder's `.paused` arm takes the same finishing path with the
96	    /// segment's output already closed — and the status item is FROZEN at
97	    /// the mark it shows, because the tick goes on through `.stopping` with
98	    /// `paused` false and would bring the coral dot back over a finish that
99	    /// captures nothing (R2 review; the footnote holds its mark the same
100	    /// way, `refreshStatusLabel`). While `.starting`: launched, the stop is
101	    /// held by the recorder and lands through `onFinish`; not yet, the
102	    /// attempt is abandoned (the type doc).
103	    func stopRecording() {
104	        switch phase {
105	        case .recording, .paused:
106	            statusItem?.freeze()
107	            phase = .stopping
108	            recorder.stop()
109	        case .starting where launched:
110	            phase = .stopping
111	            recorder.stop()
112	        case .starting:
113	            abandonStart()
114	        default:
115	            NSSound.beep()
116	        }
117	    }

119	    // MARK: - The grants
120	
121	    private func beginIfGranted() {
122	        if voiceOverSelected { return beginVoiceOverIfGranted() }
123	        if cameraSelected { return beginCameraIfGranted() }
124	        if sourcePopup.selectedItem?.tag == Self.windowTag, pickedFilter == nil {
125	            setNote(Self.chooseWindowSentence)
126	            return
127	        }
128	        if cameraBesideSelected, selectedCameraID == nil {
129	            setNote(CameraDevices.noCameraSentence)
130	            return
131	        }
132	        guard checkScreenRecordingGrant(), checkInputMonitoringGrant(),
133	            !cameraBesideSelected || checkCameraGrant(), checkMicrophoneGrant()
134	        else { return }
135	        setNote("")
136	        beginCountdown()
137	    }
138	
139	    // MARK: - The countdown
140	
141	    /// 3, 2, 1 in the panel, one second each — `TimelineView.flashRefusal`'s
142	    /// shape: `[weak self]`, self-invalidating — added to the main run loop
143	    /// in `.common` modes (the type doc). The Record button reads Cancel
144	    /// meanwhile, and a click on it or closing the panel ends the countdown
145	    /// with nothing started. The microphone the choice names is prepared
146	    /// here, after the grants and before the first second has passed, so its
147	    /// start cost is paid while the numeral is still on screen — and the
148	    /// tick is armed at once, so the meter reads that session through the
149	    /// 3-2-1 (#98 c). A `resumeProblem` left by the last recording is cleared
150	    /// first, so its sentence does not carry into this one's note (#193).
151	    func beginCountdown() {
152	        countdownTimer?.invalidate()
153	        resumeProblem = nil
154	        phase = .countdown(Self.countdownSeconds)
155	        recorder.prepareCamera(for: currentChoice())
156	        recorder.prepareMicrophone(currentChoice().microphone)
157	        armTick()
158	        let timer = Timer(timeInterval: 1, repeats: true) { [weak self] timer in
159	            guard let self, case .countdown(let remaining) = self.phase else {
160	                timer.invalidate()
161	                return
162	            }
163	            if remaining > 1 {
164	                self.phase = .countdown(remaining - 1)
165	            } else {
166	                timer.invalidate()
167	                self.countdownTimer = nil
168	                self.startRecording()
169	            }
170	        }
171	        RunLoop.main.add(timer, forMode: .common)
172	        countdownTimer = timer
173	    }
174	
175	    func cancelCountdown() {
176	        countdownTimer?.invalidate()
177	        countdownTimer = nil
178	        recorder.discardPreparedMicrophone()
179	        recorder.discardPreparedCamera()
180	        if case .countdown = phase { phase = .idle }
181	    }
182	
183	    // MARK: - Start
184	
185	    /// The choice as the controls stand, then the filter: a picked window's
186	    /// is the picker's own; a display's is built from the shareable content
187	    /// and leaves out what `recordingExclusion(includeFrameJobWindows:)`
188	    /// names (`ScreenRecorder.filter(for:in:excluding:)`) — Frame Job's own
189	    /// application, which keeps the document windows out of a display
190	    /// recording's picture, or with Include Frame Job windows on the panel's
191	    /// window alone. One attempt, numbered and bounded (the type doc).
192	    private func startRecording() {
193	        let choice = currentChoice()
194	        let exclusion = recordingExclusion(includeFrameJobWindows: choice.includeFrameJobWindows)
195	        startGeneration += 1
196	        let generation = startGeneration
197	        launched = false
198	        phase = .starting
199	        // A voice-over has no lookup to bound (`+VoiceOver.swift`).
200	        if choice.source == .voiceOver { return launchVoiceOver(choice) }
201	        // Nor does a camera: the recorder's own arm ceiling bounds it.
202	        if choice.source == .camera { return launchCamera(choice) }
203	        startTimer?.invalidate()
204	        startTimer = Timer.scheduledTimer(
205	            withTimeInterval: ScreenRecorder.armCeiling, repeats: false
206	        ) { [weak self] _ in self?.armTimedOut(generation: generation) }
207	        if choice.source == .picked, let filter = pickedFilter {
208	            launch(filter: filter, choice: choice)
209	            return
210	        }
211	        ScreenRecorder.shareableContent { [weak self] outcome in
212	            guard let self, self.phase == .starting, generation == self.startGeneration else {
213	                return
214	            }
215	            switch outcome {
216	            case .failure(let error):
217	                self.startFailed(error)
218	            case .success(let content):
219	                do {
220	                    let filter = try ScreenRecorder.filter(
221	                        for: choice.source, in: content, excluding: exclusion)
222	                    self.launch(filter: filter, choice: choice)
223	                } catch {
224	                    self.startFailed(error)
225	                }
226	            }
227	        }
228	    }
229	
230	    /// The arm ceiling, for the lookup half of an attempt: a stale number, a
231	    /// phase that moved on, or an attempt the recorder already holds (its
232	    /// own ceiling reports that one) does nothing. Internal so a probe can
233	    /// fire it without a lookup.
234	    func armTimedOut(generation: Int) {
235	        guard phase == .starting, generation == startGeneration, !launched else { return }
236	        startFailed(RecorderError.startTimedOut)
237	    }
238	
239	    /// A Stop before the recorder was handed the attempt: the pending
240	    /// lookup's answer is orphaned by the generation bump, the prepared
241	    /// microphone let go, and the panel idle with a note saying nothing was
242	    /// recorded.
243	    private func abandonStart() {
244	        startGeneration += 1
245	        startTimer?.invalidate()
246	        startTimer = nil
247	        recorder.discardPreparedMicrophone()
248	        recorder.discardPreparedCamera()
249	        phase = .idle
250	        setNote(Self.abandonedSentence)
251	    }
252	
253	    private func launch(filter: SCContentFilter, choice: RecordingChoice) {
254	        // From here the recorder's arm ceiling is the bound.
255	        startTimer?.invalidate()
256	        startTimer = nil
257	        launched = true
258	        recorder.start(
259	            filter: filter, choice: choice, mayAsk: true,
260	            onFinish: { [weak self] outcome in self?.recordingEnded(outcome) }
261	        ) { [weak self] error in
262	            guard let self else { return }
263	            if let error {
264	                self.startFailed(error)
265	                return
266	            }
267	            self.recordingDidStart()
268	        }
269	    }
270	
271	    /// A refused, failed or timed-out start: idle, the note, and the
272	    /// microphone the countdown prepared let go.
273	    func startFailed(_ error: any Error) {
274	        startTimer?.invalidate()
275	        startTimer = nil
276	        launched = false
277	        recorder.discardPreparedMicrophone()
278	        recorder.discardPreparedCamera()
279	        phase = .idle
280	        setNote(error.localizedDescription)
281	    }
282	
283	    /// The recording chrome (decision 7): the status item in the menu bar
284	    /// with Pause, Resume and Stop (`+Pause.swift` for the first two), the
285	    /// 30 Hz tick, and the panel ordered OUT for EVERY source until the
286	    /// landing has something to say — whether or not it was on screen
287	    /// (`show()` beeps meanwhile; `showWhenLanded` remembers, and
288	    /// `revealIfNoted` reads it). R1 hid it for a picked window only,
289	    /// because a display's filter excludes Frame Job (R0 q3); the user asked
290	    /// for the dialog to go away whatever is recorded, and the menu bar's
291	    /// item is the recording's controls now. A voice-over and a camera are
292	    /// the exceptions (`hidesForRecording`): the panel stays as it was, so it is never
293	    /// `hiddenForRecording` and `showWhenLanded` is simply whether it is up.
294	    func recordingDidStart() {
295	        // A stop asked for while arming has moved the phase on; the end
296	        // comes through `recordingEnded`.
297	        guard phase == .starting else { return }
298	        phase = .recording
299	        resumeProblem = nil
300	        setNote("")
301	        let item = RecorderStatusItem(
302	            keys: recorder.recordsKeys,
303	            onPause: { [weak self] in self?.pauseRecording() },
304	            onResume: { [weak self] in self?.resumeRecording() },
305	            onStop: { [weak self] in self?.stopRecording() })
306	        item.show()
307	        statusItem = item
308	        armTick()
309	        showWhenLanded = window?.isVisible == true
310	        guard Self.hidesForRecording(currentChoice().source) else { return }
311	        hiddenForRecording = true
312	        window?.orderOut(nil)
313	    }
314	
315	    // MARK: - The tick
316	
317	    /// 30 Hz from the countdown's start, in `.common` modes (the type doc).
318	    /// Through `.countdown` and `.starting` it ONLY meters — the prepared
319	    /// session's level (#98 c; the recorder publishes nothing while
320	    /// arming, so the bar holds its last pre-roll level for that instant).
321	    /// While recording or paused: the microphone's level into the panel's
322	    /// own meter (`ScreenRecorder.publishMicrophoneLevel`, a no-op without
323	    /// a microphone and while paused, the recorder having silenced the
324	    /// bar), the elapsed time in the footnote and in the status item — with
325	    /// `paused`, which is what flips the item's menu — and a microphone
326	    /// problem into the note. `recordingDidStart` re-arms it.
327	    private func armTick() {
328	        tickTimer?.invalidate()
329	        let timer = Timer(timeInterval: 1.0 / 30, repeats: true) { [weak self] timer in
330	            guard let self else {
331	                timer.invalidate()
332	                return
333	            }
334	            switch self.phase {
335	            case .countdown, .starting:
336	                self.recorder.publishMicrophoneLevel()
337	                return
338	            default:
339	                break
340	            }
341	            guard self.phase == .recording || self.phase == .paused || self.phase == .stopping
342	            else {
343	                timer.invalidate()
344	                return
345	            }
346	            self.recorder.publishMicrophoneLevel()
347	            self.refreshStatusLabel()
348	            self.statusItem?.update(elapsed: self.recorder.elapsed, paused: self.phase == .paused)
349	            self.syncMicrophoneNote()
350	        }
351	        RunLoop.main.add(timer, forMode: .common)
352	        tickTimer = timer
353	    }
354	
355	    /// The live note — what the panel says while a recording runs or is
356	    /// paused — rebuilt at every tick from its two PARTS and never from the
357	    /// label's text: `ScreenRecorder.microphoneProblem` the moment it is
358	    /// non-nil (a device unplugged, a writer that gave up), and
359	    /// `resumeProblem`, a resume the recorder refused (`+Pause.swift`,
360	    /// whose `liveNote` is the composition). Composing from the label was
361	    /// the R2 review's defect: a microphone did-finish landing late
362	    /// replaced a note that did not yet contain its sentence and wiped the
363	    /// resume's, and each retried resume appended its sentence again. Set
364	    /// only on a change, because `setNote` refits the window and this runs
365	    /// at 30 Hz.
366	    func syncMicrophoneNote() {
367	        let text = Self.liveNote(
368	            microphoneProblem: recorder.microphoneProblem, resumeProblem: resumeProblem)
369	        if noteLabel.stringValue != text { setNote(text) }
370	    }
371	
372	    func disarmTick() {
373	        tickTimer?.invalidate()
374	        tickTimer = nil
375	    }
376	}
377	import AppKit
378	
379	/// The recorder panel from the recording's END to the note that says where
380	/// it went (road map 3, R1c) — `RecorderPanelController.swift`'s fourth
381	/// file, cut out of `+Recording.swift` along the line `recordingEnded`
382	/// draws when the R1 review's fixes took that file past the 400-line cap:
383	/// everything before the session's `onFinish` fires stays there, everything
384	/// after it is here.
385	///
386	/// **One door for a finished recording.** The session's `onFinish` — called
387	/// exactly once whoever ended the recording: the panel's Stop, the status
388	/// item's, the system indicator's, a display that slept, a failure — arrives
389	/// at `recordingEnded`, which tears the recording chrome down (the tick, the
390	/// status item, and the `hiddenForRecording` flag that made `show()` beep —
391	/// clearing it, and showing NOTHING) and then lands. A DOCUMENT target
392	/// commits the placement through the document's
393	/// own door (`performGroupedEdit`, then `generateCaches`, the selection, and
394	/// the editor told through `viewStateDidChange`); a NEW PROJECT is
395	/// `ProjectDocument.untitled(around:)`, which does everything. A document
396	/// mid-drag is not committed over the gesture's base handle: the landing is
397	/// retried from a half-second timer until the drag ends, bounded at forty
398	/// tries — **20 s, kept** (lane C's flag, closed by reading): a landing that
399	/// waited for ever would hold the file's note back for ever, and the note
400	/// after the bound names the file, which is on disk either way — and on
401	/// either failure the note names the FILE, which is on disk whatever went
402	/// wrong after it. That timer stays in the DEFAULT run-loop mode on
403	/// purpose, unlike the countdown and the tick: a drag runs the loop in
404	/// tracking mode, so the retry fires when the drag ENDS, which is the
405	/// moment it is for.
406	///
407	/// **The commit is checked by its handle** (R1 review). `performGroupedEdit`
408	/// answers nothing: a refusal beeps or puts up the core's sentence on the
409	/// document's window and returns, and the panel — which cannot see either
410	/// — used to report "added" over a project with nothing in it. The
411	/// document's `project` handle changes ONLY on success (`applyEdit`'s three
412	/// outcomes), so `land` reads it before the commit and compares after, and
413	/// an unchanged handle is a failed landing with the file's path in the
414	/// note. The trial in `RecordingLanding.placement` sees everything the
415	/// commit will, so the arm is reached only by a race the trial cannot see —
416	/// an edit landing between the two on the same run-loop turn — and it is
417	/// there because the alternative is a note that lies.
418	///
419	/// **The note says six things, in order**, through `landingNote`, a pure
420	/// function so a probe can pin every combination without a landing: how the
421	/// recording ended when it was not this panel's own Stop (`.stopped` is the
422	/// status item's Stop too; `.userStopped` is the SYSTEM's indicator, and the
423	/// sentence names it so, now that Frame Job's own item is a menu-bar item as
424	/// well); that the document the person CHOSE had closed, when the choice
425	/// was a document and the landing opened a new project (R1 review — the
426	/// fallback is exact, and a person who chose "Untitled 2" should not have
427	/// to work out why a new window appeared instead); the segments left out
428	/// because their movie would not probe (`unreadableNote`, #97), each naming
429	/// the files it kept; the microphone's
430	/// problem, when the recording is a `.success` whose `micProblem` is set —
431	/// a success, not an error, so the picture lands first and the sentence
432	/// follows it; a resume the recorder refused (`resumeProblem`, STATE on the
433	/// panel and never text read back off the label — the R2 review's defect:
434	/// each end replaced the label whole, so after a refused resume and a clean
435	/// Stop the note was empty and the reveal showed nothing, the opposite of
436	/// what `+Pause.swift` promised); and the placement's own notes, one per
437	/// file the landing could not place. `failedToLand` names every file
438	/// through `filesClause` and carries the unreadable segments', the
439	/// microphone's and the resume's sentences too.
440	///
441	/// **The panel comes back ONLY with something to say** (decision 7, R2c).
442	/// It ordered out at `recordingDidStart` whatever the source, and each of
443	/// the three ends — `landed`, `failedToLand`, the failure arm of
444	/// `recordingEnded` — finishes with `revealIfNoted()`, AFTER its note is
445	/// set: the panel is ordered front when it was on screen as the recording
446	/// began (`showWhenLanded`) and the note is non-empty, and `showWhenLanded`
447	/// is cleared either way. A clean recording lands in its document or opens
448	/// its project and the panel stays away; ⌥⌘N shows it again. The reveal
449	/// belongs to the END and not to `recordingEnded`, because the deferred
450	/// landing's retries can put twenty seconds between the two, and a panel
451	/// shown with "Adding…" and no note yet is the dialog the user asked to be
452	/// rid of.
453	extension RecorderPanelController {
454	    static let landingRetryInterval: TimeInterval = 0.5
455	    static let landingRetryLimit = 40
456	    static let destinationClosedSentence =
457	        "The document you chose was closed, so the recording opened as a new project."
458	
459	    // MARK: - The end, and the landing
460	
461	    func recordingEnded(_ outcome: Result<RecordingResult, Error>) {
462	        disarmTick()
463	        statusItem?.remove()
464	        statusItem = nil
465	        launched = false
466	        hiddenForRecording = false
467	        switch outcome {
468	        case .failure(let error):
469	            phase = .idle
470	            setNote(
471	                [error.localizedDescription, resumeProblem].compactMap { $0 }
472	                    .joined(separator: " "))
473	            revealIfNoted()
474	        case .success(let result):
475	            phase = .landing
476	            landingAttempts = 0
477	            land(result)
478	        }
479	    }
480	
481	    func land(_ result: RecordingResult) {
482	        switch RecordingLanding.resolve(result.choice.destination) {
483	        case .document(let document):
484	            guard !document.isLiveEditing else {
485	                deferLanding(result)
486	                return
487	            }
488	            do {
489	                let placement = try RecordingLanding.placement(result, in: document, place: true)
490	                let before = document.project
491	                document.performGroupedEdit(RecordingLanding.actionName, placement.ops)
492	                // The handle changes only on success (the type doc).
493	                guard document.project !== before else {
494	                    failedToLand(
495	                        result,
496	                        ReelCoreError(
497	                            message: "the project refused the placement and nothing was added"))
498	                    return
499	                }
500	                document.generateCaches()
501	                // Every segment's clip, microphone clips included (R2b); a
502	                // segment that minted none is a nil entry, and its sentence
503	                // is in `placement.notes`.
504	                document.selection = Set(
505	                    (placement.clipIds + placement.micClipIds + placement.leftOutMicClipIds
506	                        + placement.cameraClipIds)
507	                        .compactMap { $0 })
508	                Self.editor(of: document)?.viewStateDidChange()
509	                landed(result, asNewProject: false, notes: placement.notes)
510	                RecordingCutout.apply(result, in: document)  // CO-81: its own step, first
511	                RecordingEnhance.follow(result, in: document)  // AU-68: after the commit
512	                RecordingPolish.follow(result, in: document)  // CU-100: after it, its own steps
513	            } catch {
514	                failedToLand(result, error)
515	            }
516	        case .newProject:
517	            do {
518	                let (opened, notes) = try ProjectDocument.untitled(around: result)
519	                landed(result, asNewProject: true, notes: notes)
520	                RecordingCutout.apply(result, in: opened)  // CO-81: its own step, first
521	                RecordingEnhance.follow(result, in: opened)  // AU-68: after the commit
522	                RecordingPolish.follow(result, in: opened)  // CU-100: after it, its own steps
523	            } catch {
524	                failedToLand(result, error)
525	            }
526	        }
527	    }
528	
529	    /// A drag is in progress: try again when it has had half a second to
530	    /// end, up to the limit — a landing over the gesture's base handle would
531	    /// be undone by the gesture's own end.
532	    private func deferLanding(_ result: RecordingResult) {
533	        landingAttempts += 1
534	        guard landingAttempts <= Self.landingRetryLimit else {
535	            let waited = Int(Double(Self.landingRetryLimit) * Self.landingRetryInterval)
536	            failedToLand(
537	                result,
538	                ReelCoreError(message: "A drag was still in progress after \(waited) s."))
539	            return
540	        }
541	        landingTimer?.invalidate()
542	        landingTimer = Timer.scheduledTimer(
543	            withTimeInterval: Self.landingRetryInterval, repeats: false
544	        ) { [weak self] _ in
545	            self?.landingTimer = nil
546	            self?.land(result)
547	        }
548	    }
549	
550	    /// Back to idle; the note is `landingNote`'s, over the placement's own
551	    /// notes — the unreadable segments' sentences followed by what became of
552	    /// their readable voices (#181 item 2), said only here, on a landing
553	    /// that succeeded — led by every segment's camera sentences beside the
554	    /// screen (`cameraSegmentsNote`, spec §11 CAM-10 (8)) — and the reveal
555	    /// last.
556	    private func landed(_ result: RecordingResult, asNewProject: Bool, notes placed: [String]) {
557	        phase = .idle
558	        rebuildDestinations()
559	        // Then every segment's cursor problem (spec §11 CU-18).
560	        let notes = [result.cameraSegmentsNote, result.cursorSegmentsNote].compactMap { $0 } + placed
561	        let leftOut = [result.unreadableNote, result.leftOutVoiceNote].compactMap { $0 }
562	        setNote(
563	            Self.landingNote(
564	                stoppedBy: result.stoppedBy, chosen: result.choice.destination,
565	                landedAsNewProject: asNewProject, micProblem: result.micProblem,
566	                resumeProblem: resumeProblem, notes: notes,
567	                unreadable: leftOut.isEmpty ? nil : leftOut.joined(separator: " "),
568	                camera: result.camera, cameraBeside: result.camera != nil && !result.isCamera))
569	        revealIfNoted()
570	    }
571	
572	    /// The files are on disk whatever went wrong after them, so the note
573	    /// names every one (`filesClause`: each segment's movie, and the
574	    /// microphone files that landed) — then what became of an unreadable
575	    /// segment, the microphone, the camera (its `problem` and warm-up `note`,
576	    /// spec §11 CAM-5, then each segment's camera sentences beside the
577	    /// screen, CAM-10 (8)) and a refused resume, when the result or the panel
578	    /// carries those sentences — and the reveal last.
579	    private func failedToLand(_ result: RecordingResult, _ error: any Error) {
580	        phase = .idle
581	        var note =
582	            "The recording was saved at \(result.filesClause) but could not be added: "
583	            + error.localizedDescription
584	        for sentence in [
585	            result.unreadableNote, result.micProblem, result.camera?.problem, result.camera?.note,
586	            result.cameraSegmentsNote, result.cursorSegmentsNote, resumeProblem,
587	        ].compactMap({ $0 })
588	        {
589	            note += " " + sentence
590	        }
591	        setNote(note)
592	        revealIfNoted()
593	    }
594	
595	    /// The panel back on screen after a landing, ONLY when it was on screen
596	    /// as the recording began and the note has something in it (the type
597	    /// doc). Called LAST by each of the three ends, after the note is set —
598	    /// which is the whole point — and reached after the deferred landing's
599	    /// retries as well, since nothing before it clears `showWhenLanded`.
600	    /// Cleared either way, so a later `show()` of the person's own is not
601	    /// mistaken for this one. Internal so a probe can drive both ways.
602	    func revealIfNoted() {
603	        if showWhenLanded, !noteLabel.stringValue.isEmpty { window?.orderFront(nil) }
604	        showWhenLanded = false
605	    }
606	
607	    /// The landing's note (the type doc): the stop's sentence unless the
608	    /// stop was this panel's own; the closed-document sentence when a chosen
609	    /// document was gone by the time the recording ended; the unreadable
610	    /// segments' sentences; the microphone's problem; a refused resume's
611	    /// sentence; then the placement's notes. Empty for the ordinary case, so
612	    /// `setNote` hides the label. The R2 arguments, #97's `unreadable` and
613	    /// CR1c's `camera` are LAST and default, so the probe's R1 rows read as
614	    /// they did. A CAMERA result (spec §11 CAM-5) says its own stop — the
615	    /// camera's `problem`, else that it stopped on its own — in place of the
616	    /// display's, and its warm-up `note` follows the microphone's problem.
617	    /// A camera BESIDE the screen (`cameraBeside`, spec §11 CAM-10 (8)) is
618	    /// not the recording's stop: the display's sentence stays, and the
619	    /// camera's `problem` follows the microphone's problem, before its note.
620	    static func landingNote(
621	        stoppedBy: StopReason, chosen: RecordingDestination, landedAsNewProject: Bool,
622	        micProblem: String?, resumeProblem: String? = nil, notes: [String] = [],
623	        unreadable: String? = nil, camera: RecordingCamera? = nil, cameraBeside: Bool = false
624	    ) -> String {
625	        var sentences: [String] = []
626	        switch stoppedBy {
627	        case .stopped:
628	            break
629	        case .userStopped:
630	            sentences.append(
631	                "Stopped from the system's screen-recording indicator; the recording was added.")
632	        case .systemStopped:
633	            if let camera, !cameraBeside {
634	                sentences.append(
635	                    (camera.problem ?? "The camera stopped on its own.")
636	                        + " What was captured was added.")
637	            } else {
638	                sentences.append(
639	                    "The system stopped the recording (the display slept or went away); "
640	                        + "what was captured was added.")
641	            }
642	        }
643	        if case .document = chosen, landedAsNewProject {
644	            sentences.append(destinationClosedSentence)
645	        }
646	        if let unreadable { sentences.append(unreadable) }
647	        if let micProblem { sentences.append(micProblem) }
648	        if cameraBeside, let problem = camera?.problem { sentences.append(problem) }
649	        if let note = camera?.note { sentences.append(note) }
650	        if let resumeProblem { sentences.append(resumeProblem) }
651	        sentences.append(contentsOf: notes)
652	        return sentences.joined(separator: " ")
653	    }
654	
655	    /// `AgentServer.editor(_:)`'s lookup; nil for a windowless document.
656	    static func editor(of document: ProjectDocument) -> EditorViewController? {
657	        document.windowControllers
658	            .compactMap { $0.contentViewController as? EditorViewController }
659	            .first
660	    }
661	}

4	/// The Source row "Camera" — a CAMERA recording from the panel

241	/// What the camera preview's well does at one sync (spec §11 CAM-7 (3)).
242	enum CameraPreviewStep: Equatable {
243	    case off
244	    case message(String)
245	    case failed(String)
246	    case prepare
247	    case prepared
248	    case recording
249	    case blank
250	}

252	/// The camera's live preview in the panel (camera-recording CR2b, spec §11
253	/// CAM-7) — `RecorderPanelController.swift`'s eleventh file, NEW rather than
254	/// cut, as `+Camera.swift` was: the rule that says what the well shows, and
255	/// the one sync that acts on it. The well is `CameraPreviewWell`, a grid row
256	/// of its own right under Format (`+Rows.swift`), shown only while a camera
257	/// is wanted: Source Camera, or "Record the camera too" beside a screen
258	/// source (spec §11 CAM-11 (4)).
259	///
260	/// **The step** (`cameraPreviewStep`, pure, first match wins): a panel not
261	/// visible or closing, or no camera wanted → off; a camera recording, or a
262	/// screen recording's camera beside it → its layer; the countdown or
263	/// starting → the prepared layer, never a build; any other phase, or a
264	/// busy recorder → blank; no camera → "No camera is connected."; the
265	/// Camera grant not authorized → a sentence; a prepared capture that
266	/// failed, or a build that threw → its sentence, never retried; else
267	/// prepare. The grant is read only at its own step, through
268	/// `grantDoors.cameraStatus`, so showing the panel never prompts and a
269	/// hidden panel reads nothing.
270	///
271	/// **The sync** runs at the end of `show()`, of every control change, of
272	/// `syncPhase()`, at the one-second tick while the panel is visible, and at
273	/// each device notification. Its first act applies a pending hot-plug
274	/// (`+Devices.swift`, CAM-8 (2)), so the step sees the new selection. It
275	/// keeps the row's visibility (refitting the window when it changes), lets
276	/// the prepared capture go when the well is off or shows a sentence while
277	/// everything is idle, stops a failed prepared capture once (not at every
278	/// tick, CAM-8 (6)), and otherwise hosts the layer the step names. The
279	/// capture is the recorder's (`ScreenRecorder+CameraPrepare.swift`): the
280	/// countdown's `prepareCamera` keeps it, the panel's start adopts it, and a
281	/// tool's start never does (CAM-7 (7)), so through a tool's recording the
282	/// well reads "The camera is recording."
283	extension RecorderPanelController {
284	    static let previewGrantSentence = "The preview shows once Frame Job may use the camera."
285	    static let previewRecordingSentence = "The camera is recording."
286	
287	    /// CAM-7 (3)'s rule. `grant` and `failure` are called only at their own
288	    /// steps.
289	    static func cameraPreviewStep(
290	        visible: Bool, cameraSource: Bool, phase: Phase, recorderIdle: Bool,
291	        recordingCamera: Bool, cameraChosen: Bool, grant: () -> AVAuthorizationStatus,
292	        failure: () -> String?
293	    ) -> CameraPreviewStep {
294	        guard visible, cameraSource else { return .off }
295	        if recordingCamera { return .recording }
296	        switch phase {
297	        case .countdown, .starting: return .prepared
298	        case .idle: break
299	        case .recording, .paused, .stopping, .landing: return .blank
300	        }
301	        guard recorderIdle else { return .blank }
302	        guard cameraChosen else { return .message(CameraDevices.noCameraSentence) }
303	        guard grant() == .authorized else { return .message(Self.previewGrantSentence) }
304	        if let failure = failure() { return .failed(failure) }
305	        return .prepare
306	    }
307	
308	    /// The well's grid row.
309	    var cameraPreviewRow: NSGridRow? {
310	        (cameraPreview.superview as? NSGridView)?.cell(for: cameraPreview)?.row
311	    }
312	
313	    /// For the chosen camera at its resolved format (CAM-6 (3)): the
314	    /// prepared capture's stop on its own, else its failed start, else a
315	    /// failed build's record; nil when there is none.
316	    var previewFailure: String? {
317	        guard let id = selectedCameraID, let device = CameraDevices.device(withID: id) else {
318	            return nil
319	        }
320	        let facts = CameraDevices.facts(of: device)
321	        guard
322	            let format = CameraDevices.chosenFormat(
323	                selectedCameraFormat, in: facts.formats, active: facts.activeFormat)
324	        else { return nil }
325	        if let prepared = recorder.preparedCamera, prepared.deviceID == id, prepared.format == format,
326	            let sentence = prepared.stoppedOnItsOwn ?? prepared.startError?.localizedDescription
327	        {
328	            return sentence
329	        }
330	        guard let failure = recorder.preparedCameraFailure, failure.deviceID == id,
331	            failure.format == format
332	        else { return nil }
333	        return failure.sentence
334	    }
335	
336	    /// A pending hot-plug applied (CAM-8 (2)), the row's visibility, then the
337	    /// step acted on (the type doc).
338	    func syncCameraPreview() {
339	        applyPendingDevices()
340	        let hidden = !cameraWanted
341	        if let row = cameraPreviewRow, row.isHidden != hidden {
342	            row.isHidden = hidden
343	            fitWindowToContent()
344	        }
345	        let step = Self.cameraPreviewStep(
346	            visible: window?.isVisible == true && !panelClosing, cameraSource: cameraWanted,
347	            phase: phase, recorderIdle: recorder.state == .idle,
348	            recordingCamera: recorder.cameraSession != nil || recorder.session?.cameraCapture != nil,
349	            cameraChosen: selectedCameraID != nil,
350	            grant: { Self.grantDoors.cameraStatus() }, failure: { self.previewFailure })
351	        switch step {
352	        case .off, .message:
353	            if phase == .idle, recorder.state == .idle { recorder.discardPreparedCamera() }
354	            if case .message(let sentence) = step {
355	                cameraPreview.showMessage(sentence)
356	            } else {
357	                cameraPreview.showMessage(nil)
358	            }
359	        case .failed(let sentence):
360	            if let capture = recorder.preparedCamera?.capture, !capture.stopped { capture.stop() }
361	            cameraPreview.showMessage(sentence)
362	        case .prepare:
363	            recorder.prepareCamera(for: currentChoice())
364	            hostPreview(recorder.preparedCamera?.capture.previewLayer, else: nil)
365	        case .prepared:
366	            hostPreview(recorder.preparedCamera?.capture.previewLayer, else: nil)
367	        case .recording:
368	            hostPreview(
369	                (recorder.cameraSession?.capture ?? recorder.session?.cameraCapture)?.previewLayer,
370	                else: Self.previewRecordingSentence)
371	        case .blank:
372	            cameraPreview.showMessage(nil)
373	        }
374	    }
375	
376	    /// `layer` in the well, else `sentence` (nil a blank well).
377	    private func hostPreview(_ layer: AVCaptureVideoPreviewLayer?, else sentence: String?) {
378	        if let layer {
379	            cameraPreview.show(layer)
380	        } else {
381	            cameraPreview.showMessage(sentence)
382	        }
383	    }
384	}

388	/// One popup row as a hot-plug compares it: the id it carries (nil for
389	/// "None connected" and "Off") and its title.
390	struct HotPlugRow: Equatable {
391	    let id: String?
392	    let title: String
393	}
394	
395	/// Hot-plug (camera-recording CR2c, spec §11 CAM-8) —
396	/// `RecorderPanelController.swift`'s twelfth file, NEW rather than cut, as
397	/// `+Camera.swift` and `+CameraPreview.swift` were: the device observers,
398	/// the pending mark, the rebuild it applies, the selection rule and the
399	/// microphone list.
400	///
401	/// **The observers** are `AVCaptureDevice`'s connected and disconnected
402	/// notifications for any device, on main. `show()` adds the pair (one at
403	/// most) and adding it marks the lists pending, so a change made while the
404	/// panel was closed is caught up; `panelWillClose` removes them. A panel
405	/// ordered out for a recording keeps them.
406	///
407	/// **Pending until idle.** A notification marks the lists pending and steps
408	/// the preview (`syncCameraPreview`), whose FIRST act is
409	/// `applyPendingDevices`: it applies only while the panel's phase and the
410	/// recorder are both idle, so a change during a countdown, a recording or a
411	/// landing waits for the first step that finds both idle — the return to
412	/// idle draws the phase, which steps. It never steps the preview itself (no
413	/// recursion) and never persists.
414	///
415	/// **The rebuild** compares each popup's rows (id, title) with the devices
416	/// connected now and rebuilds only a popup that differs, so a menu the
417	/// person has open is not rebuilt for an unrelated device. The selection is
418	/// `hotPlugSelection` over the id held BEFORE the rebuild; the camera is
419	/// selected again — which rebuilds the Format popup, the stored format else
420	/// Best (CAM-6 (2)) — only when its popup was rebuilt or the id changed.
421	/// **No key is written**, so a camera that goes and comes back is selected
422	/// again with its stored format; the next control change writes what the
423	/// popups then show (CAM-5 (2)).
424	extension RecorderPanelController {
425	
426	    /// CAM-8 (3): `stored` when `listed` holds it, else `current` when
427	    /// listed, else nil (the default). `""` counts as nil for both.
428	    static func hotPlugSelection(listed: [String], stored: String?, current: String?) -> String? {
429	        let stored = stored.flatMap { $0.isEmpty ? nil : $0 }
430	        let current = current.flatMap { $0.isEmpty ? nil : $0 }
431	        if let stored, listed.contains(stored) { return stored }
432	        if let current, listed.contains(current) { return current }
433	        return nil
434	    }
435	
436	    /// The microphones connected now: the discovery session
437	    /// `ScreenRecorder.microphone(withID:)` asks, keeping only those whose
438	    /// `isConnected` is true (CAM-8 (5)).
439	    static func connectedMicrophones() -> [AVCaptureDevice] {
440	        AVCaptureDevice.DiscoverySession(
441	            deviceTypes: [.microphone, .external], mediaType: .audio, position: .unspecified
442	        ).devices.filter(\.isConnected)
443	    }
444	
445	    /// `popup`'s rows as a hot-plug compares them.
446	    static func hotPlugRows(of popup: NSPopUpButton) -> [HotPlugRow] {
447	        popup.itemArray.map { HotPlugRow(id: $0.representedObject as? String, title: $0.title) }
448	    }
449	
450	    // MARK: - The observers
451	
452	    /// Idempotent: one pair at most. Adding the pair marks the lists
453	    /// pending, so the sync that follows catches up a change made while the
454	    /// panel was closed.
455	    func observeDevices() {
456	        guard deviceObservers.isEmpty else { return }
457	        let center = NotificationCenter.default
458	        let names = [AVCaptureDevice.wasConnectedNotification, AVCaptureDevice.wasDisconnectedNotification]
459	        for name in names {
460	            let observer = center.addObserver(forName: name, object: nil, queue: .main) {
461	                [weak self] _ in
462	                self?.devicesDidChange()
463	            }
464	            deviceObservers.append(observer)
465	        }
466	        devicesPending = true
467	    }
468	
469	    /// Removes both observers.
470	    func stopObservingDevices() {
471	        deviceObservers.forEach(NotificationCenter.default.removeObserver)
472	        deviceObservers = []
473	    }
474	
475	    /// A device came or went: the lists are pending, and the preview's step
476	    /// applies them first when the panel and the recorder are idle.
477	    func devicesDidChange() {
478	        devicesPending = true
479	        syncCameraPreview()
480	    }
481	
482	    // MARK: - The rebuild
483	
484	    /// CAM-8 (2)–(4): nothing unless pending and both idle; then each popup
485	    /// rebuilt only when its rows differ from the devices connected now, the
486	    /// selection `hotPlugSelection`'s, and the size note refreshed. Writes
487	    /// no key and never steps the preview.
488	    func applyPendingDevices() {
489	        guard devicesPending else { return }
490	        guard phase == .idle, recorder.state == .idle else { return }
491	        devicesPending = false
492	        let defaults = UserDefaults.standard
493	
494	        let cameras = CameraDevices.connected()
495	        let cameraRows =
496	            cameras.isEmpty
497	            ? [HotPlugRow(id: nil, title: Self.noCameraTitle)]
498	            : cameras.map {
499	                HotPlugRow(id: $0.uniqueID, title: CameraDevices.popupTitle(CameraDevices.facts(of: $0)))
500	            }
501	        let currentCamera = selectedCameraID
502	        let cameraRebuilt = Self.hotPlugRows(of: cameraPopup) != cameraRows
503	        if cameraRebuilt { rebuildCameras() }
504	        let camera = Self.hotPlugSelection(
505	            listed: cameras.map(\.uniqueID), stored: defaults.string(forKey: Self.cameraKey),
506	            current: currentCamera)
507	        if cameraRebuilt || camera != selectedCameraID { selectCamera(camera) }
508	
509	        let microphones = Self.connectedMicrophones()
510	        let microphoneRows =
511	            [HotPlugRow(id: nil, title: "Off")]
512	            + microphones.map { HotPlugRow(id: $0.uniqueID, title: $0.localizedName) }
513	        let currentMicrophone = microphonePopup.selectedItem?.representedObject as? String
514	        if Self.hotPlugRows(of: microphonePopup) != microphoneRows { rebuildMicrophones() }
515	        selectMicrophone(
516	            Self.hotPlugSelection(
517	                listed: microphones.map(\.uniqueID),
518	                stored: defaults.string(forKey: Self.microphoneKey), current: currentMicrophone))
519	        // AU-69 (a): the Enhance box follows a microphone that came or went.
520	        enhanceMicrophoneCheckbox.isEnabled = currentChoice().microphone != nil
521	        refreshSizeNote()
522	    }
523	}

533	/// a value, so `.picked` is the one source that cannot persist), and a
534	/// cancel or a failure puts the Source row back on the display the person

536	/// refused by name in `+Recording.swift`, never answered by presenting the

541	    /// `SCContentSharingPicker` in single-window mode, what
542	    /// `recordingExclusion(includeFrameJobWindows:)` names excluded from the
543	    /// LIST — Frame Job's application with Include Frame Job windows off, the
544	    /// panel's own window alone with it on (spec §11 recording.md).
545	    /// `excludedBundleIDs` is documented "for picking" and says nothing about

548	    /// exclusion is about the list only. The observer is added once; the
549	    /// picker is activated for the presentation and deactivated when it
550	    /// answers.
551	    func presentPicker() {
552	        let exclusion = recordingExclusion(
553	            includeFrameJobWindows: includeFrameJobCheckbox.state == .on)
554	        let picker = SCContentSharingPicker.shared
555	        if !pickerObserved {
556	            picker.add(self)

558	        }

560	        configuration.allowedPickerModes = [.singleWindow]
561	        configuration.excludedBundleIDs = exclusion.bundleIDs
562	        configuration.excludedWindowIDs = exclusion.windowIDs.map { Int($0) }

569	    /// recording.md, Include Frame Job windows): Frame Job's application with
